text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency breach detected on /v1/chat/completions (hosted) - route=chat.completions, model=mistral-instruct-7b, region=us-west-2. p99=2.8s (SLO 1.2s). Volume spike noted: 3x baseline. Auto-scaling triggered but observed queueing. Incident ID INC-4521.

Maria L.: acked, i'm on it. paging @oncall (Jon). starting triage — checking queues and model pool utilization.

Jon K.: joining. pulled up the dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/alerts/INC-4521 - looks like a thin spike concentrated on route `chat.completions` for model mistral-instruct-7b and a smaller delta on redwood-13b.

Sahil P.: logs show a cluster of long-running requests, many with long system prompts (avg tokens per request jumped ~2.5x). might be a prompt abuse pattern or large-batch batching mismatch.

Kevin M.: checking dedicated pool autoscaler logs. scaling events succeeded but new workers took ~45s to become ready. meanwhile request queue grew. adding a short-term mitigation: routing a subset of traffic to redwood-13b fallback.

Maria L.: doing the routing change now. command: ```rdctl routing update --route chat.completions --policy split --weights "mistral-instruct-7b:70,redwood-13b:30" --reason "mitigation INC-4521"```

OpsPager: PagerDuty: alert acknowledged by Maria L. (on-call). Estimated impact: 18% of requests > p99 threshold; some customer timeouts at 30s.

Jon K.: routing change applied. verifying metrics... p99 dropped to ~1.6s for split traffic within 2m. still seeing some noisy retries from clients. Can we temporarily lower client retry attempt TTL?

Eva R.: reaching out to Platform to throttle retries at the edge. Added a quick fix in edge config: ```edge-config set chat.completions max_retries 2 retry_backoff_ms 500``` — rolling out now.

Sahil P.: noted that KV cache miss rate increased because of longer prompts. Suggest enabling prefix caching for the top 10 user agents for next 30m. Will open config patch.

Maria L.: while we have it warm, let's also adjust alerting to reduce noise: the current p99 alert is global and is firing on short lived load spikes. Propose: change p99 alert to be per-model and add a 2-minute sustained window and mute models with qps < 5. Draft: `if (p99_lat > 1.5s && sustained_for >= 120s && qps >= 5) trigger`. Thoughts?

Jon K.: +1. Also add p95 warning tier at 0.9s to catch slowdowns earlier but keep quieter. We should create separate alerts per-route (chat vs completions) since embedding routes have different profiles.

Kevin M.: agree. for mistral-instruct-7b specifically, historical p99 sits ~0.9s; set model-specific p99 threshold 1.4s. For redwood-13b p99 threshold can be 1.8s. I'll create the alert PR.

Maria L.: creating follow-up ticket ENG-OBS-789 to (1) implement per-model per-route p95/p99 thresholds, (2) add sustained window and min-qps gating, (3) update runbook with mitigation steps we used (split routing, reduce retries, enable prefix cache).

IncidentBot: NOTE: Incident INC-4521 marked as mitigated at 1769006121 by Maria L. Reason: split routing + edge retry throttling reduced p99 to <1.2s.

Jon K.: handing off to second-shift. @Jon K. -> @Kevin M. you're next on-call for follow-up?

Kevin M.: taking it. I'll finish the alert PR and dashboard panels: per-model p95/p99 heatmap, per-route time-series, and a small traffic-sensitivity table (qps buckets). Plan to ship before EOD.

Eva R.: quick note for customer impact: I contacted CS; initial customers impacted were 3 paid accounts with timeouts in the 15-30s window — they were routed to fallback and requests retried successfully. CS informed and draft post-incident note ready.

Maria L.: postmortem checklist: - attach graphs (latency, qps, pool size) - timeline with actions and commands - alert PR link - runbook update - customer-notification draft. Moving to post-incident review in 48h.

Kevin M.: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/512 — includes the per-model thresholds and the 120s sustained gating. cc @eng-sre for review.

Jon K.: small follow-up: please add an annotation on the dashboard at 1769004321 with note "INC-4521: split routing mitigation" so we can correlate.

Maria L.: done. added annotation and pinned the logs snippet to the incident.

OpsPager: Reminder: handoff checklist completed. Second-shift owner: Kevin M. If anything degrades, re-open INC-4521 or escalate directly via PD. :thumbsup:

Kevin M.: closing thread here, will post PR status and runbook updates in ENG-OBS-789. thanks team. :raised_hands:
